🧹 Nitpick comments: 1
test/controllers/reports_controller_test.rb: 1
`764-770`: **🎯 Functional Correctness** | **🔵 Trivial** | **⚡ Quick win** **Assert the modal escape target.** The Google Sheets link is opened inside the `modal` Turbo Frame. Without `_top`, Turbo can replace that frame with the empty modal frame from the settings layout instead of navigating to the API keys page. The current test performs a normal request and would pass if the frame target were removed.
Suggested fix ```diff - assert_select "a[href=?]", settings_api_keys_path, text: I18n.t("reports.google_sheets_instructions.go_to_api_keys") + assert_select "a[href=?][data-turbo-frame=?]", settings_api_keys_path, "_top", + text: I18n.t("reports.google_sheets_instructions.go_to_api_keys") ```
